note: crossClassReads counts member calls on `this.<f>` whose file types `<f>` in a class OTHER than the one the call sits in. The analyzer keys field types by FIELD NAME alone (collectLocalReceiverTypes -> fieldTypes), so such a call carries the OTHER class as metadata.owner. If that class declares the member, the store binds the edge to it — a wrong resolution. conflictReads counts calls on a field typed two ways in one file: the owner is withdrawn, so the row is safe but unresolved.
